messages:
alex_devex: Quick micro-standup — very short today. What I did: landed node quickstart rewrite (PR #482), fixed ESM import example, updated package.json snippets. Blockers: flaky sampleapp test on mac M1 (failing in CI intermittently). Today: open a follow-up PR to pin dev deps and finish the README examples.

nina_docs: Nice, saw the PR. Quick note — the code block in the README still uses `require()` in one place, can you switch that to `import` for the ESM quickstart? small UX hiccup.

alex_devex: yep on it, will push a small commit. Also adding a one-line troubleshooting section for M1.

sam_engineer: re: CI flaky test — the failure looks like a timing issue in the sampleapp startup. Can you drop in a retry or increase the wait for the health check? I can send a patch if you want.

alex_devex: please do, a quick retry wrapper around the readiness probe should be fine. If you push, I'll watch the CI.

ci-bot: build started for PR #482 (linux, macos-m1). Logs: https://ci.internal/r/482/build/1

nina_docs: FYI I'll batch a small docs release for Friday that includes the ESM quickstart and the SDK snippets fix. If CI green, can you add the changelog blurb?

alex_devex: will add changelog when CI passes. Also tagging translators for the short snippet — /cc @localized-team (not here, but I'll notify).

tom_solutions: quick question: sampleapp uses the new batching config by default now? I noticed a small perf delta on my laptop.

alex_devex: yes, sampleapp enables auto-batching in dev mode (to show cost savings). We have a note in config but I'll make it more prominent.

sam_engineer: pushed a tiny fix to #482 that retries the health check (3 attempts, 2s backoff).

ci-bot: build restarted for PR #482 (macos-m1) — current run: https://ci.internal/r/482/build/2

deploy-bot: staging deploy queued for branch docs/quickstart-esm once CI is green.

nina_docs: blockers for me: waiting on screenshots from design for the quickstart flow. If they come today I can finish the docs release.

alex_devex: noted. If screenshots are late, I'll add temporary annotated GIFs and swap later.

sam_engineer: CI is green on my end for mac, mac M1 looks stable in this run. :thumbsup:

alex_devex: excellent — thanks everyone. I'll merge after CI completes, then update the changelog and ping marketing for the short blurb. If anything else pops up, @channel but otherwise quiet day for me.

nina_docs: thanks — will queue the release notes draft.

ci-bot: PR #482 merged by alex_devex at 1769503735

deploy-bot: staging deploy started at 1769503740 for tag docs-quickstart-esm-1769503740
